description: Asked after Saturday and after a moon, and was told the second was not a promise.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, put threepence on the slate, and shut the talk of going.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said the baker's loaf was light as well, and said when he would be at the loom.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Ate, named the threepence and the sixpence as different sums, and promised nothing about Saturday.
name: William Shakespeare
